properties.title: The domain's edge crosses the East Australian Current
properties.message: Open boundaries work best where strong currents cross them at right angles; where the East Australian Current enters at a steep angle it reflects and causes artifacts.
properties.instruction: Move the edge, or rotate the grid (mom6_forge's Grid.from_center with angle_deg) so the current crosses it squarely.

references.title: Expert interview 1: Coral Triangle & Benguela Upwelling

evidence.quote: Open boundary conditions are more stable when energetic currents cross them perpendicularly.
Rotating your domain so that the main current crosses the boundary perpendicularly helps a lot.
